title: Delivery approvals
description: Request client feedback on project milestones and track their approvals in one place.
noClient: Link a client to this project before requesting a review.
noMilestones: Create a milestone here, then describe the delivery and request the client’s review.
requestNote: The client can read this note. Their decision applies to the milestone as it was when requested. After changes, edit the milestone before requesting another review.
milestoneLimit: Showing the 200 most recently updated milestones.
requested: Review requested. The client can respond on the project page in their portal.
requestError: Could not request review. Refresh and check the milestone and client before retrying.
error: Could not load reviews. Refresh to try again.
staleNote: The milestone or client changed. A new review is required.
decisionNote: Your decision is recorded for this version. It does not automatically change the milestone's progress.
decisionError: Could not confirm your decision. Refresh to check its status; the version may have changed.
portalRequired: The linked client does not have active portal access. Open their client record and enable access before requesting a review.
reviewNotFoundHint: Open all reviews to see the requests currently available to you.
emptyReadyHint: Choose a milestone and describe what you need the client to review.
emptyReaderHint: When a milestone is submitted for review, its request, feedback, and decision appear here.
historyHint: Requests and decisions retain the delivery details as they were submitted. Approval does not automatically complete the milestone or project.
existingRequestFound: An existing request was found and is shown below. No new request was created.
commentPlaceholder: Share your feedback or describe the changes you need.
sourceChanged: The milestone has changed. Refresh and review its current details before continuing.
clientChanged: The project’s client changed while this window was open. Close and reopen the request to verify the recipient before sending.
alreadyDecided: A decision has already been recorded. Refresh to view the latest result.
milestoneDialogDescription: Define the delivery milestone before asking the client to review it.
requestDialogDescription: Choose a milestone and give the client clear instructions for their review.
portalDeliveryHint: The request will be available on the project page in the client’s portal.
alreadyRequested: This milestone already has a request for its current details. Open it, or edit the milestone before requesting another review.
notePlaceholder: Describe the delivery and the feedback you need from the client.
editMilestoneHint: Changing this milestone makes its pending reviews outdated. Save the changes, then request a new review if needed.
createMilestoneHint: Name the delivery and optionally set a due date. After saving, you can add instructions and request the client’s review.
milestoneChanged: This milestone changed while you were editing. Close this window, refresh approvals, and reopen the milestone before saving.
milestoneSaveError: Could not save the milestone. Check its title and due date, then try again.
requestForbidden: Your account does not have permission to request reviews for this project.
